project.name: Market Data Pipeline
project.goal: Build the data layer every other desk will reason from, in the project repo, within four weeks: daily prices and fundamentals for a US equity universe I name, loaded on a schedule that re-runs unattended. Prices are split- and dividend-adjusted consistently and labelled as adjusted or raw. Fundamentals are point-in-time, carrying the date each figure became known, not just the period it describes. Delisted and merged symbols stay in the store. Every load validates on arrival — row counts against the trading calendar, no duplicate keys, no non-positive prices, no gaps on trading days — and fails loudly rather than writing suspect rows. Ship the schema documentation and the freshness contract for each dataset, including what its vendor licence allows.
